alternate_exit.description: No second door is visible in the frames. Stay at the front door if it is blocked.
alternate_exit.when: Use only if the brown front door is blocked. Call for help and wait.

answer.notes_for_helper: She lives alone, finds stairs hard, and has no car. Please give an arm and bring a ride.

obstacles_now.fix: Do not use these steps alone. Use the flat front door with a helper.
obstacles_now.what: Rough tall stone steps behind the shed are uneven and hard on knees.

obstacles_now.fix: Move the stool and bags away now to keep the patio clear.
obstacles_now.what: Small stool and clutter by the wooden shed block the exit path.

obstacles_now.fix: Walk slow with a helper. Wear non-slip shoes. No handrail is visible.
obstacles_now.what: The red concrete path is sloped and can be slippery when wet.

primary_exit.description: Go out the brown wooden front door marked 12a.
primary_exit.why: The doorway is flat to the patio with no steps. It is safest for stairs that are hard.

route_steps.landmark: black mat on the stone patio in front of door 12a
route_steps.step: Step out the brown door onto the flat stone patio by the black mat.

route_steps.landmark: small wooden shed with red roof by the stone pillar
route_steps.step: Turn left past the small wooden shed. Stay on the flat grass.

route_steps.landmark: lone small tree beside the red-brown concrete path
route_steps.step: Follow the red-brown path past the small tree. Walk with your helper.

route_steps.landmark: white house with brown tile roof at the top of the path
route_steps.step: Wait at the flat top by the white house for your ride. Do not go back.
